acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.owner_: Operator allowed to submit UniswapX fills and administer policy controls.
params.policySigner_: EOA whose EIP-712 signatures authorize exact maker executions.
params.reactor_: Immutable UniswapX reactor allowed to enter the callback.
params.router_: Immutable SwapVM router used by every maker leg.

eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

executeRebate((address,uint256,bytes),(u.details: The caller supplies the exact signed input plus rebate and receives the exact signed output.      The signature intentionally leaves the executor open so any solver can compete to include      the restoration; the unordered nonce allows only the first successful execution.

fillBatch((bytes,bytes)[],((address,uint.details: Source legs are shared across the batch and intentionally need not match its order count.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

reactorCallback(((address,address,uint25.details: This callback deliberately does not take the reentrancy lock: it must re-enter while      `fill` or `fillBatch` holds that lock. The transient reactor marker limits entry to the      immutable reactor during the active outer call, and every source still consumes a nonce.

params.callbackData: The callbackData specified for an order execution

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

executeRebate((address,uint256,bytes),(u.notice: Execute an authorized price-restoring swap and pay its rebate directly to the maker.

fill((bytes,bytes),((address,uint256,byt.notice: Fill one UniswapX order using policy-authorized Aqua maker legs.

fillBatch((bytes,bytes)[],((address,uint.notice: Fill a batch of UniswapX orders using one shared authorized maker plan.

hashAuthorization((uint8,uint256,bytes32.notice: Returns the EIP-712 digest the policy signer must sign.

invalidateNonces(uint256,uint256).notice: Cancels any subset of 256 unordered nonces in one storage word.

isNonceUsed(uint256).notice: Reports whether an authorization nonce has been executed or invalidated.

pause().notice: Stops new fills and rebate executions while preserving recovery controls.

reactorCallback(((address,address,uint25.notice: Called by the reactor during the execution of an order

renounceOwnership().notice: Keeps an operator available for signer rotation, incident response, and recovery.

setPolicySigner(address).notice: Rotates the EOA trusted to authorize maker executions.

setTokenAllowed(address,bool).notice: Restricts execution to tokens whose ERC-20 behavior the operator has reviewed.

sweep(address,address).notice: Withdraw accrued spread or a stray token. The filler is not a vault.

userFillBatchContext((bytes,bytes)[]).notice: Binds a shared maker plan to an ordered batch of signed UniswapX orders.

userFillContext((bytes,bytes)).notice: Binds a maker plan to the complete signed UniswapX order.
